user_flow: 1. Open Editor for a PPT-imported project with backgroundImage slides
2. Click TTS button in toolbar to open Text-to-Speech dialog
5. Wait for loading (shows 'Gerando 3 opções com Gemini...')
6. Gemini reads the slide image via OCR/vision and generates 3 contextual narration options
7. 3 narration options appear - each references actual slide content
8. Click on an option to select it and fill the text field
9. Toast 'Texto de narração selecionado!' confirms selection
10. Proceed with TTS generation using selected text
